local accepted = {RNGGui=true, Tutorial=true, SnowArrivalGui=true, DiceBannerGui=true, TreasureToastGui=true, World2Toast=true, StageToast=true, FrostfallToast=true}
local seen = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local function rootOf(o)
	local root = o:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScreenGui")
	if root and accepted[root.Name] then return root end
	local bb = o:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BillboardGui")
	if bb and (bb.Name:sub(1,8)=="PetSign_" or bb.Name=="SnowPrompt") then return bb end
	local surface = o:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("SurfaceGui")
	local zones = workspace:FindFirstChild("SnowFieldZones")
	if surface and not (zones and surface:IsDescendantOf(zones)) then return surface end
end
local function apply(o)
	if not o or not o.Parent or o:GetAttribute("SnowUIDecor") or seen[o] or not o:IsA("GuiObject") then return end
	local root = rootOf(o)
	if not root then return end
	if o:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
		o.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(124,224,255)
		o.ScrollBarThickness = math.min(o.ScrollBarThickness,7)
		seen[o] = true return
	end
	if o:IsA("ImageLabel") and o.Name=="Background" and o.Parent.Parent and o.Parent.Parent.Name=="Panels" then
		seen[o] = true
		whenReady(M.Assets.panel,function()
			if o.Parent then o.Image=M.Assets.panel o.ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Slice o.SliceCenter=M.Slice o.SliceScale=0.2 end
		end)
		return
	end
	if o.Name=="Shadow" or o.Name=="Glow" or o.Name=="Aura" or o.Name=="Fill" or o.Name=="Shine" then return end
	if root:IsA("SurfaceGui") and o.Parent==root and o.BackgroundTransparency<0.9 then
		if not o:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner") then
			local c=Instance.new("UICorner") c.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0.1,0) c.Parent=o
		end
		seen[o]=true M.Skin(o,"card") return
	end
	if o:IsA("Frame") or o:IsA("TextButton") or o:IsA("TextBox") then
		if o.BackgroundTransparency>=0.9 or not o:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner") then return end
		-- A sibling border follows the automatic-size box without influencing its measurement.
		if o.AutomaticSize~=Enum.AutomaticSize.None then
			if root.Name=="Tutorial" then
				o.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(18,73,122)
				seen[o]=true
				-- 2026-10-04 (Claude): one clean icy outline instead of the frosty sibling border image
				if not o:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke") then
					local s=Instance.new("UIStroke") s.Thickness=3 s.Color=Color3.fromRGB(150,215,255) s.ApplyStrokeMode=Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border s.Parent=o
				end
			end
			return
		end
		local content=o:IsA("TextButton") or o:IsA("TextBox")
		for _,c in ipairs(o:GetChildren()) do
			if c:IsA("TextLabel") or c:IsA("ViewportFrame") or c:IsA("ImageLabel") or c:IsA("TextButton") then content=true break end
		end
		if not content then return end
		seen[o]=true
		M.Skin(o,o:IsA("TextButton") and "button" or "card")
	end
end
function M.Attach(container)
	for _,o in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do apply(o) end
	return container.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(o)
		task.defer(function()
			if o:IsA("UICorner") or o:IsA("TextLabel") or o:IsA("ViewportFrame") then apply(o.Parent) end
			apply(o)
		end)
	end)
end
function M.StyleTree(container)
	for _,o in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do apply(o) end
end
function M.SnowBackground(parent)
	local img=M.Icon(parent,M.Assets.loading,UDim2.fromScale(0,0),UDim2.fromScale(1,1),"SnowBackdrop")
	img.ZIndex=0 img.ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Crop
	img.ImageColor3=Color3.fromRGB(100,140,185) img.ImageTransparency=0.52
	return img
end
return M

-- TreasureModels (2026-10-01, Claude): chunky procedural 3D treasures for TreasureConfig items (+ the menu chest).
-- Build(item) returns an anchored, non-colliding Model about 2 studs across; PrimaryPart "Root" sits at its centre.
local M = {}
local SMOOTH, NEON = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Enum.Material.Neon
local CF, ANG, R = CFrame.new, CFrame.Angles, math.rad
local FACE = ANG(0, R(90), 0)  -- cylinder axis (X) turned to face forward (Z)
local UP = ANG(0, 0, R(90))    -- cylinder axis (X) turned upright (Y)
local DARK = Color3.fromRGB(45, 40, 60)
local WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)

local function part(m, name, shape, size, color, cf, mat, tr)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name = name
	p.Shape = shape
	p.Size = size
	p.Color = color
	p.Material = mat or SMOOTH
	p.Transparency = tr or 0
	p.CFrame = cf or CF()
	p.Anchored = true
	p.CanCollide = false
	p.CanQuery = false
	p.CanTouch = false
	p.CastShadow = false
	p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.Parent = m
	return p
end
local function ball(m, n, d, c, cf, mat, tr) return part(m, n, Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.new(d, d, d), c, cf, mat, tr) end
local function block(m, n, s, c, cf, mat, tr) return part(m, n, Enum.PartType.Block, s, c, cf, mat, tr) end
local function cyl(m, n, len, d, c, cf, mat, tr) return part(m, n, Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Vector3.new(len, d, d), c, cf, mat, tr) end
local function ell(m, n, s, c, cf, mat, tr)
	local p = block(m, n, s, c, cf, mat, tr)
	local sm = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
	sm.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.Sphere
	sm.Parent = p
	return p
end
local function beads(m, n, radius, count, d, c, cf, mat)
	for i = 1, count do
		local a = i / count * math.pi * 2
		ball(m, n .. i, d, c, cf * CF(math.cos(a) * radius, math.sin(a) * radius, 0), mat)
	end
end
local function shade(c, k) return c:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), k) end

local B = {}
function B.button(m, it)
	cyl(m, "Disc", 0.4, 1.9, it.A, FACE)

end

	for i = 0, 2 do block(m, "Arm" .. i, Vector3.new(0.26, 2.1, 0.26), it.A, ANG(0, 0, R(60 * i))) end
	for i = 0, 5 do
		local a = R(60 * i)
		ball(m, "Tip" .. i, 0.4, it.B, CF(math.sin(a) * 1.05, math.cos(a) * 1.05, 0))
		block(m, "Twig" .. i, Vector3.new(0.16, 0.5, 0.16), it.A, CF(math.sin(a) * 0.62, math.cos(a) * 0.62, 0) * ANG(0, 0, -a + R(90)))

function B.bell(m, it)
	ell(m, "Dome", Vector3.new(1.55, 1.75, 1.55), it.A, CF(0, 0.1, 0), SMOOTH, 0.08)
	cyl(m, "Lip", 0.32, 1.95, it.A, CF(0, -0.62, 0) * UP)
	cyl(m, "Band", 0.22, 1.62, it.B, CF(0, -0.25, 0) * UP)
	ball(m, "Clapper", 0.5, it.B, CF(0, -0.88, 0), NEON)

function B.watch(m, it)
	cyl(m, "Case", 0.46, 1.85, it.A, FACE)
	cyl(m, "Face", 0.5, 1.45, it.B, FACE)
	block(m, "HourHand", Vector3.new(0.13, 0.45, 0.06), DARK, CF(0, 0.2, 0.27))
	block(m, "MinuteHand", Vector3.new(0.1, 0.62, 0.06), DARK, CF(0.24, 0.12, 0.27) * ANG(0, 0, R(-60)))

function B.bone(m, it)

local function scaled(sequence, scale)
	local points={}
	for _,k in ipairs(sequence.Keypoints) do
		table.insert(points,NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(k.Time,k.Value*scale,k.Envelope*scale))
	end
	return NumberSequence.new(points)
end

-- Returns a disabled, unparented Attachment; safe to keep in a template library.
function M.MakePreset(name)
	local def=assert(definitions[name],"Unknown VFX preset: "..tostring(name))
	local a=Instance.new("Attachment")
	a.Name=name
	a.Position=def.Offset or Vector3.zero
	a:SetAttribute("UniversalVFXPreset",name)
	a:SetAttribute("Burst",def.Burst==true)
	for _,properties in ipairs(def.Emitters) do
		local e=Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		e.Enabled=false e.LightInfluence=0 e.EmissionDirection=Enum.NormalId.Top e.ZOffset=0.1
		for key,value in pairs(properties) do
			if key=="Texture" then e.Texture=assert(M.Textures[value],"Missing VFX texture: "..value)
			elseif key=="BurstCount" then e:SetAttribute(key,value)
			else e[key]=value end
		end
		e.Parent=a
	end
	return a
end

-- Attach to a BasePart on the client for local visuals. Call handle:Destroy() when finished.
-- Options: Color (Color3), Scale (0.1..4), Quality (0.1..1), Offset (Vector3), Enabled (boolean).
function M.Attach(part,name,options)
	assert(typeof(part)=="Instance" and part:IsA("BasePart"),"VFX target must be a BasePart")
	local options=options or {}
	local scale=math.clamp(tonumber(options.Scale) or 1,0.1,4)
	local quality=math.clamp(tonumber(options.Quality) or 1,0.1,1)
	local root=M.MakePreset(name)
	if typeof(options.Offset)=="Vector3" then root.Position=options.Offset end
	local life=0
	for _,e in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do if e:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
		e.Size=scaled(e.Size,scale) e.Speed=NumberRange.new(e.Speed.Min*scale,e.Speed.Max*scale)
		e.Acceleration*=scale e.Rate*=quality
		if typeof(options.Color)=="Color3" then e.Color=ColorSequence.new(options.Color) end
		life=math.max(life,e.Lifetime.Max)
		e.Enabled=not root:GetAttribute("Burst") and options.Enabled~=false
	end end
	root.Parent=part
	local handle={Root=root,Lifetime=life}
	function handle:SetEnabled(value)
		if not self.Root.Parent then return end
		for _,e in ipairs(self.Root:GetChildren()) do if e:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then e.Enabled=value==true end end
	end
	function handle:Emit()
		if not self.Root.Parent then return end
		for _,e in ipairs(self.Root:GetChildren()) do if e:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			local count=e:GetAttribute("BurstCount") or 1
			e:Emit(math.clamp(math.ceil(count*quality),1,32))
		end end
	end
	function handle:Destroy() self.Root:Destroy() end
	return handle
end

-- One-shot effect with automatic cleanup after the longest particle lifetime.
function M.Burst(part,name,options)
	local handle=M.Attach(part,name,options)
	handle:SetEnabled(false)
	handle:Emit()
	Debris:AddItem(handle.Root,handle.Lifetime+0.2)
	return handle
end
return M

U.Base = {SizeMult = 1, SpinMult = 1, WalkSpeed = 16, ShovelSlots = 2, PetSlots = 3, PowerBonus = 0, EggDiscount = 0, LuckMult = 1, FriendBoost = 0, RollAnimScale = 1, ReachMult = 1, DoubleRollChance = 0, SnowMult = 1, PowerMult = 1, PetBoostMult = 1, GoldenEvery = 0, RainbowEvery = 0, GoldenLuck = 3, RainbowLuck = 10}
U.Limits = {EggDiscount = {0, 0.5}, DoubleRollChance = {0, 0.5}, RollAnimScale = {0.6, 1}, ReachMult = {1, 1.5}, SpinMult = {1, 1.6}, WalkSpeed = {16, 40}, PetBoostMult = {1, 2}, FriendBoost = {0, 0.2}, GoldenEvery = {0, 10}, RainbowEvery = {0, 100}}
-- lookups
U.ById, U.TreeById = {}, {}
for _, tree in ipairs(U.Trees) do
	U.TreeById[tree.Id] = tree
	tree.ByPos = {}
	for _, n in ipairs(tree.Nodes) do
		n.Tree = tree.Id
		U.ById[n.Id] = n
		tree.ByPos[n.Q .. "," .. n.R] = n
	end
end

local DIRS = {{1, 0}, {-1, 0}, {0, 1}, {0, -1}, {1, -1}, {-1, 1}}
function U.Neighbours(n)
	local tree = U.TreeById[n.Tree]
	local out = {}
	for _, d in ipairs(DIRS) do
		local nb = tree.ByPos[(n.Q + d[1]) .. "," .. (n.R + d[2])]
		if nb then table.insert(out, nb) end
	end
	return out
end
function U.Distance(n) return math.max(math.abs(n.Q), math.abs(n.R), math.abs(n.Q + n.R)) end
function U.CostOf(n)
	if n.Cost then return n.Cost end
	local tree = U.TreeById[n.Tree]
	return math.floor(tree.BaseCost * tree.Growth ^ U.Distance(n) * (n.CostMult or 1) + 0.5)
end
-- 2026-10-02 (Claude): Cost-0 stages (World 2 Sakura) open together with the stage before them, exactly like StageService.isOpen.
local StageConfig = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("StageConfig"))
local function openViaPrevious(stage, stages)
	local s = StageConfig.ById[stage]
	while s and s.Cost == 0 do
		local prev = StageConfig.Previous(s.Id)
		if not prev then return false end
		if stages and stages[prev.Id] then return true end
		s = prev
	end
	return false
end
-- A client and the server use the same stage and adjacency rules.
function U.LockReason(n, owned, stages)
 if owned[n.Id] then return "Owned" end
 local stage = n.RequiredStage or "Starter"
 if stage ~= "Starter" and not (stages and stages[stage]) and not openViaPrevious(stage, stages) then
  return "Unlock " .. (({Cursed = "Cursed Biome", Crystal = "Crystal Caves", Retro = "Retro World", AbsoluteZero = "Absolute Zero", Portal = "Absolute Zero Portal"})[stage] or (StageConfig.ById[stage] and StageConfig.ById[stage].Name) or stage) .. " first"
 end
 if n.Center then return nil end
 for _, nb in ipairs(U.Neighbours(n)) do if owned[nb.Id] then return nil end end
 return "Buy a connected tile first"
end
function U.Available(n, owned, stages) return U.LockReason(n, owned, stages) == nil end
function U.Calculate(owned, friends)
 local stats, mults = table.clone(U.Base), {}
 for id, has in pairs(owned) do
  local n = has and U.ById[id]
  if n and n.Effect then
   local e = n.Effect
   if e[3] == "Mul" then mults[e[1]] = (mults[e[1]] or 1) * (1 + e[2])
   else stats[e[1]] = (stats[e[1]] or 0) + e[2] end
  end
 end
 for k, m in pairs(mults) do stats[k] *= m end
 for k, lim in pairs(U.Limits) do stats[k] = math.clamp(stats[k], lim[1], lim[2]) end
 local friendMult = 1 + stats.FriendBoost * math.clamp(friends or 0, 0, 3)
 stats.SnowMult *= friendMult
 stats.LuckMult *= friendMult
 return stats
end
-- 2026-10-04 (Claude, pacing v3 - user: "even out and boost upgrades"):
--  * NO upgrade is blocked by a stage.
--  * World 1 prices follow ONE smooth curve: upgrades are ordered by tier (old stage lock, or ring for the Snow/Rolls trees), then
--    ring, then old price, and priced from PriceStart up to PriceEnd geometrically (~25% more per step). PriceEnd = 1/4 of the stage
--    after Absolute Zero, capped at 31x Absolute Zero, so a pricey Portal can't create a price wall. World 2 (W2_) prices unchanged.
--  * World 1 snow, shovel damage, luck and size upgrades are 30% stronger (descriptions rewritten to match).
--  * Three filler "+1 walk speed" tiles now unlock the lobby machines (owners of those tiles get the machine for free).
U.RingTier = {
	Snow  = {[2] = "Desert", [3] = "Cursed", [4] = "Crystal", [5] = "Retro", [6] = "Jungle"},
	Rolls = {[2] = "Desert", [3] = "Cursed", [4] = "Crystal", [5] = "Crystal", [6] = "Retro", [7] = "Retro", [8] = "Jungle", [9] = "Jungle", [10] = "AbsoluteZero"},
}
U.PriceStart = 15
U.BoostWorld1 = 1.3
U.MachineUnlocks = {
	M_Pet1 = {Name = "Shovel Forge", Text = "Unlocks the Shovel Forge in the lobby", Effect = {"UnlockForge", 1}, Cost = 3000, IconFrom = "S_Heavy"},
	M_Expansion2 = {Name = "Pet Fuser", Text = "Unlocks the Pet Fuser in the lobby", Effect = {"UnlockFuser", 1}, Cost = 60000, IconFrom = "M_Equip1"},
	M_Expansion5 = {Name = "Crafting Machine", Text = "Unlocks the Crafting Machine in the lobby", Effect = {"UnlockCraft", 1}, Cost = 1000000, IconFrom = "M_Egg3"},
}
U.Base.UnlockForge, U.Base.UnlockFuser, U.Base.UnlockCraft = 0, 0, 0
do
	local function nice(x) -- 2 significant digits
		if x < 100 then return math.floor(x + 0.5) end
		local e = 10 ^ (math.floor(math.log10(x)) - 1)
		return math.floor(x / e + 0.5) * e
	end
	local function fmt(x) return (string.format("%.2f", x):gsub("0+$", ""):gsub("%.$", "")) end
	local function step(x) if x < 1 then return math.max(0.05, math.floor(x / 0.05 + 0.5) * 0.05) end return math.floor(x / 0.5 + 0.5) * 0.5 end
	-- the machine unlocks (fixed prices, not on the curve)
	for id, props in pairs(U.MachineUnlocks) do
		local n = U.ById[id]
		if n then
			local src = props.IconFrom and U.ById[props.IconFrom]
			n.Name, n.Text, n.Effect, n.Cost = props.Name, props.Text, props.Effect, props.Cost
			if src and src.Icon then n.Icon = src.Icon end
			n.FixedPrice = true
		end
	end
	-- one smooth curve for World 1
	local rank = {}
	for i, s in ipairs(StageConfig.Order) do rank[s.Id] = i end
	local items = {}
	for id, n in pairs(U.ById) do
		if not id:find("^W2_") and not n.FixedPrice then
			local map = U.RingTier[n.Tree]
			local tier = n.RequiredStage or (map and map[U.Distance(n)]) or "Starter"
			table.insert(items, {n = n, t = rank[tier] or 1, d = U.Distance(n), c = U.CostOf(n)})
		end
	end
	table.sort(items, function(a, b)
		if a.t ~= b.t then return a.t < b.t end
		if a.d ~= b.d then return a.d < b.d end
		if a.c ~= b.c then return a.c < b.c end
		return a.n.Id < b.n.Id
	end)
	local azCost, after = 2.5e11, nil
	for i, s in ipairs(StageConfig.Order) do
		if s.Id == "AbsoluteZero" then azCost = s.Cost; after = StageConfig.Order[i + 1] end
	end
	local p0 = U.PriceStart
	local p1 = 0.25 * math.min(after and after.Cost > 0 and after.Cost or azCost * 31, azCost * 31)
	U.PriceEnd = p1
	for k, it in ipairs(items) do
		it.n.Cost = nice(p0 * (p1 / p0) ^ ((k - 1) / math.max(#items - 1, 1)))
	end
	-- boost: World 1 snow / damage / luck / size upgrades are 30% stronger
	for id, n in pairs(U.ById) do
		local e = n.Effect
		if e and not id:find("^W2_") and not n.FixedPrice then
			if (e[1] == "SnowMult" or e[1] == "PowerMult") and e[3] == "Mul" then
				e[2] = step(e[2] * U.BoostWorld1)
				n.Text = (n.Text or ""):gsub("^x[%d%.]+", "x" .. fmt(1 + e[2]))
			elseif e[1] == "LuckMult" and e[3] == nil then
				e[2] = step(e[2] * U.BoostWorld1)
				n.Text = (n.Text or ""):gsub("^%+[%d%.]+%%", "+" .. fmt(e[2] * 100) .. "%%")
			elseif e[1] == "SizeMult" and e[3] == nil then
				e[2] = 0.08
				n.Text = (n.Text or ""):gsub("^%+[%d%.]+%%", "+8%%")
			end
		end
	end
	for _, n in pairs(U.ById) do n.RequiredStage = nil end -- no stage locks on upgrades
end

return U

-- WheelConfig (2026-10-03, Claude): the Lucky Wheel. You get 1 free spin for every newly unlocked stage (again after each rebirth).

local function remote(class, name)

	if not r then r = Instance.new(class); r.Name = name; r.Parent = RS end
	return r

local rng = Random.new()

local lastCall = {}

local function nice(x)
	x = math.max(1, x)
	if x < 100 then return math.floor(x + 0.5) end
	local e = 10 ^ (math.floor(math.log10(x)) - 1)
	return math.floor(x / e + 0.5) * e
end

-- every stat quests/achievements use, straight from the saved profile (none of them reset on rebirth)
local function stats(d)
	local a = d.Activity
	local hatches = 0
	for _, n in pairs(d.Pets or {}) do hatches += tonumber(n) or 0 end
	local bases, shovels = {}, 0
	for name, n in pairs(d.Counts or {}) do
		if (tonumber(n) or 0) > 0 then
			local it = Shovels.ByName[name]
			local base = (it and it.Base) or name
			if not bases[base] then bases[base] = true; shovels += 1 end
		end
	end
	local pets = 0
	for _, v in pairs(d.PetIndex or {}) do if v then pets += 1 end end
	return {
		Rolls = tonumber(d.TotalRolls) or 0,
		SnowEarned = tonumber(d.SnowEarned) or 0,
		Hatches = hatches,
		Treasures = tonumber(d.TreasureFound) or 0,
		ShovelsFound = shovels,
		PetsFound = pets,
		Rebirths = tonumber(d.Rebirths) or 0,
		World2 = a.World2 and 1 or 0,
		QuestsDone = a.QuestsDone,
	}
end

local function snowFor(a, minutes) return nice(math.max(100, (a.Rate or 0) * 60 * minutes)) end

local function rewardText(a, r)
	if r.SnowMinutes then return "❄️ " .. NumberFormat.Abbreviate(snowFor(a, r.SnowMinutes)) .. " Snow" end
	return A.RewardText(r)
end

local function grant(player, d, r)
	if r.Boost then
		Boosts.Add(player, r.Boost, r.Seconds)
		return A.RewardText(r)
	elseif r.SnowMinutes then
		local amount = snowFor(d.Activity, r.SnowMinutes)
		local t = track[player]
		if t then t.reward += amount end
		DataService.AddSnow(player, amount)
		return "❄️ +" .. NumberFormat.Abbreviate(amount) .. " Snow"
	end
	return ""
end

-- returns canClaim, nextDay, nextClaimTime, claimedThrough (for the 7 tiles)
local function daily(a)
	local now = os.time()
	local last = a.Daily.Last
	local lost = last > 0 and now - last > A.DailyStreakReset
	local can = last == 0 or now - last >= A.DailyCooldown
	local nextDay = (lost or a.Daily.Day >= #A.Daily) and 1 or a.Daily.Day + 1
	local through = (lost or (can and nextDay == 1)) and 0 or a.Daily.Day
	return can, nextDay, last + A.DailyCooldown, through
end

-- QUESTS
--------------------------------------------------
local function shuffled(list)
	local t = table.clone(list)
	for i = #t, 2, -1 do
		local j = rng:NextInteger(1, i)
		t[i], t[j] = t[j], t[i]
	end
	return t
end

local function newQuests(d)
	local a = d.Activity
	local st = stats(d)
	local defs = shuffled(A.Quests)
	local order = {}
	for i = 1, #A.QuestRewards do order[i] = i end
	order = shuffled(order)
	local list = {}
	for i = 1, math.min(A.QuestSlots, #defs) do
		local q = defs[i]
		local goal
		if q.Minutes then
			goal = nice(math.max(150, a.Rate * 60 * q.Minutes[rng:NextInteger(1, #q.Minutes)]))
		else
			goal = q.Amounts[rng:NextInteger(1, #q.Amounts)]
		end
		table.insert(list, {Id = q.Id, Goal = goal, Start = st[q.Stat] or 0, Reward = order[((i - 1) % #order) + 1], Claimed = false, Done = false})
	end
	a.Quests = list
	a.NextQuests = 0
end

local function questProgress(q, st)
	local def = A.QuestById[q.Id]
	if not def then return 0, def end
	return math.clamp((st[def.Stat] or 0) - (tonumber(q.Start) or 0), 0, q.Goal), def
end

-- STATE FOR THE CLIENT
--------------------------------------------------
local function snapshot(d)
	local a = d.Activity
	local st = stats(d)
	local can, nextDay, nextAt, through = daily(a)
	local dailyList = {}
	for i, r in ipairs(A.Daily) do dailyList[i] = rewardText(a, r) end
	local quests = {}
	for _, q in ipairs(a.Quests) do
		local prog, def = questProgress(q, st)
		if def then
			table.insert(quests, {Text = string.format(def.Text, NumberFormat.Abbreviate(q.Goal)), Progress = prog, Goal = q.Goal,
				Claimed = q.Claimed == true, Reward = rewardText(a, A.QuestRewards[q.Reward] or A.QuestRewards[1])})
		end
	end
	local ach = {}
	for i, x in ipairs(A.Achievements) do
		ach[i] = {Id = x.Id, Have = a.Achievements[x.Id] == true, Progress = math.min(st[x.Stat] or 0, x.Goal)}
	end
	return {Now = os.time(), Daily = {CanClaim = can, NextDay = nextDay, NextAt = nextAt, Through = through, Rewards = dailyList},
		Quests = quests, NextQuests = a.NextQuests, Achievements = ach}
end

-- TICK: speed, quests, achievements, red dot
--------------------------------------------------
local function tick(player, dt)
	local d, a = Boosts.Profile(player)
	if not a then return end
	local t = track[player]
	if not t then t = {earned = tonumber(d.SnowEarned) or 0, reward = 0}; track[player] = t end
	if player:GetAttribute("World") == 2 or (type(d.Stages) == "table" and d.Stages.Portal == true) then a.World2 = true end
	local st = stats(d)

	-- recent digging speed (snow per second, ~5 minute average), without reward snow
	local gained = math.max(0, st.SnowEarned - t.earned - t.reward)
	t.earned, t.reward = st.SnowEarned, 0
	a.Rate += (gained / dt - a.Rate) * math.min(1, dt / 300)

	-- quests: first set at once, later sets after the refresh wait
	local allClaimed = #a.Quests > 0
	for _, q in ipairs(a.Quests) do if not q.Claimed then allClaimed = false end end
	if #a.Quests == 0 then
		newQuests(d)
	elseif allClaimed and os.time() >= a.NextQuests then
		newQuests(d)
		push:FireClient(player, {Type = "NewQuests"})
	end
	local claimable = false
	for _, q in ipairs(a.Quests) do
		local prog, def = questProgress(q, st)
		if def and not q.Claimed and prog >= q.Goal then
			claimable = true
			if not q.Done then
				q.Done = true
				push:FireClient(player, {Type = "QuestDone", Text = string.format(def.Text, NumberFormat.Abbreviate(q.Goal))})
			end
		end
	end

	-- achievements (permanent bonuses)
	local unlocked = false
	for _, x in ipairs(A.Achievements) do
		if not a.Achievements[x.Id] and (st[x.Stat] or 0) >= x.Goal then
			a.Achievements[x.Id] = true
			unlocked = true
			push:FireClient(player, {Type = "Achievement", Id = x.Id})
		end
	end
	if unlocked then Boosts.Refresh(player) end

	if daily(a) then claimable = true end
	if player:GetAttribute("ActivityClaimable") ~= claimable then player:SetAttribute("ActivityClaimable", claimable) end
end

DataService.OnLoaded(function(player)
	local d = DataService.Get(player)
	if not d then return end
	Boosts.Sanitize(d)
	track[player] = {earned = tonumber(d.SnowEarned) or 0, reward = 0}
end)

		last = now

	end
end)

fn.OnServerInvoke = function(player, action, arg)
	local d, a = Boosts.Profile(player)
	if not d or not a then return nil end
	if action == "Get" then return snapshot(d) end
	local now = os.clock()
	if lastCall[player] and now - lastCall[player] < 0.4 then return {Ok = false, Msg = "Slow down!"} end
	lastCall[player] = now

	if action == "ClaimDaily" then
		local can, day = daily(a)
		if not can then return {Ok = false, Msg = "Come back later for your next reward!"} end
		a.Daily.Day = day
		a.Daily.Last = os.time()
		local text = grant(player, d, A.Daily[day])
		return {Ok = true, Msg = "Day " .. day .. ": " .. text, State = snapshot(d)}

	elseif action == "ClaimQuest" then
		local q = a.Quests[tonumber(arg) or 0]
		if not q or q.Claimed then return {Ok = false, Msg = "That quest is not available."} end
		local prog = questProgress(q, stats(d))
		if prog < q.Goal then return {Ok = false, Msg = "Finish the quest first!"} end
		q.Claimed = true
		a.QuestsDone += 1
		local text = grant(player, d, A.QuestRewards[q.Reward] or A.QuestRewards[1])
		local all = true
		for _, x in ipairs(a.Quests) do if not x.Claimed then all = false end end
		if all then a.NextQuests = os.time() + A.QuestRefresh end
		return {Ok = true, Msg = "Quest reward: " .. text, State = snapshot(d)}

	elseif action == "Redeem" then
		local code = type(arg) == "string" and arg or ""
		code = string.upper(string.gsub(code, "%s", "")):sub(1, 30)
		local r = CODES[code]
		if not r then return {Ok = false, Msg = "That code doesn't exist."} end
		if a.Codes[code] then return {Ok = false, Msg = "You already used this code."} end
		a.Codes[code] = true
		local text = grant(player, d, r)
		return {Ok = true, Msg = "Code redeemed! " .. text, State = snapshot(d)}
	end
	return nil
end

local current, token = nil, 0
local function endEvent()
	current = nil
	RS:SetAttribute("EventId", nil)
	RS:SetAttribute("EventEnds", nil)
	Boosts.SetEvent(1, 1)
	push:FireAllClients({Type = "EventEnd"})
end
local function runEvent(e, duration)
	token += 1
	local mine = token
	duration = duration or e.Duration
	current = e
	RS:SetAttribute("EventId", e.Id)
	RS:SetAttribute("EventEnds", workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + duration)
	Boosts.SetEvent(e.Snow, e.Luck)
	push:FireAllClients({Type = "EventStart", Id = e.Id})
	task.delay(duration, function() if token == mine then endEvent() end end)
end
local function pickEvent()
	local total = 0
	for _, e in ipairs(A.Events) do total += e.Weight end
	local r = rng:NextNumber() * total
	for _, e in ipairs(A.Events) do
		r -= e.Weight
		if r <= 0 then return e end
	end
	return A.Events[1]
end
task.spawn(function()
	task.wait(rng:NextNumber(A.FirstEventDelay[1], A.FirstEventDelay[2]))
	while true do
		if not current then
			local e = pickEvent()
			runEvent(e)
			task.wait(e.Duration)
		end
		task.wait(rng:NextNumber(A.EventGap[1], A.EventGap[2]))
	end
end)

local function defaults(d)
	d.Rebirths = RebirthConfig.Count(d.Rebirths)

	d.TotalRolls = tonumber(d.TotalRolls) or 0

	d.Upgrades = type(d.Upgrades) == "table" and d.Upgrades or {}
	d.Settings = type(d.Settings) == "table" and d.Settings or {}

local function load(player)
	if data[player] then return end
	local saved
	if store then
		local ok, res = pcall(function() return store:GetAsync("u" .. player.UserId) end)
		if ok and type(res) == "table" then saved = res end
	end
	if not player.Parent then return end
	local d = defaults(saved or {})
	data[player] = d
	player:SetAttribute("BalanceTestSession", testMode)
	player:SetAttribute("StarterShovelName", StarterShovelRules.Name)

	local ls = Instance.new("Folder")
	ls.Name = "leaderstats"
	stat(ls, "Snow", d.Snow)
	stat(ls, "Rolls", d.TotalRolls)
	stat(ls, "Rebirths", d.Rebirths)
	ls.Parent = player

	loaded:Fire(player, d)
end

-- Serialize autosave, rebirth, and leave saves so an older write cannot finish last.
local saving, saveAgain = {}, {}
local function save(player)
 if not store or not data[player] then return end
 if saving[player] then
  saveAgain[player] = true
  repeat task.wait() until not saving[player]
  return
 end
 saving[player] = true
 repeat
  saveAgain[player] = nil
  local snapshot = game.HttpService:JSONDecode(game.HttpService:JSONEncode(data[player]))
  local ok, err
  for attempt = 1, 3 do
   ok, err = pcall(function() store:SetAsync("u" .. player.UserId, snapshot) end)
   if ok then break end
   if attempt < 3 then task.wait(attempt) end
  end
  if not ok then warn("[DataService] Save failed: " .. tostring(err)) end
 until not saveAgain[player]
 saving[player] = nil
end

	if amount > 0 then d.SnowEarned = (tonumber(d.SnowEarned) or 0) + amount end -- lifetime snow for quests/achievements (2026-10-02)
	DataService.SetStat(player, "Snow", d.Snow)
end

local SUFFIX = {k = 1e3, m = 1e6, b = 1e9, t = 1e12, qa = 1e15, qi = 1e18}
local function amount(s)
	if not s then return nil end
	s = s:lower():gsub(",", "")
	local num, suf = s:match("^(%-?[%d%.]+)(%a*)$")
	num = tonumber(num)
	if not num then return nil end
	if suf ~= "" then
		if not SUFFIX[suf] then return nil end
		num *= SUFFIX[suf]
	end
	return num
end

local function targets(caller, s)
	if not s or s == "" or s:lower() == "me" then return {caller} end
	if s:lower() == "all" then return Players:GetPlayers() end
	local q = s:lower()
	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if p.Name:lower():sub(1, #q) == q or p.DisplayName:lower():sub(1, #q) == q then return {p} end
	end
	return {}
end

-- finds by exact name, then "starts with", then "contains"; "void" finds "Void Shovel"
local function find(list, q)
	q = (q or ""):lower()
	if q == "" then return nil end
	for _, it in ipairs(list) do if it.Name:lower() == q then return it end end
	for _, it in ipairs(list) do if it.Name:lower():sub(1, #q) == q then return it end end
	for _, it in ipairs(list) do if it.Name:lower():find(q, 1, true) then return it end end
	return nil
end

local function run(player, msg)
	if type(msg) ~= "string" or msg:sub(1, #PREFIX) ~= PREFIX then return end
	if not isAdmin(player) then return end
	local args = {}
	for w in msg:sub(#PREFIX + 1):gmatch("%S+") do table.insert(args, w) end
	local name = table.remove(args, 1)
	local cmd = name and COMMANDS[name:lower()]
	if not cmd then
		cmdEvent:FireClient(player, "Unknown command. Type " .. PREFIX .. "help", false)
		return
	end
	local ok, result, err = pcall(cmd.fn, player, args)
	if not ok then
		cmdEvent:FireClient(player, "Error: " .. tostring(result), false)
	elseif result then
		cmdEvent:FireClient(player, result, true)
	else
		cmdEvent:FireClient(player, err or "Failed", false)
	end
end

cmdEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(run)

local function onPlayer(p)
	p.Chatted:Connect(function(msg) run(p, msg) end)
	if isAdmin(p) then
		local gui = consoleTemplate:Clone()
		gui.Parent = p:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
	end
end

-- BoostService (2026-10-02, Claude): extra Snow/Luck multipliers from server events, personal timed boosts
-- (daily rewards, quests, codes) and permanent achievement bonuses.
-- UpgradeService.apply() multiplies SnowMult/LuckMult by B.Multipliers(player), so everything that already reads
-- those attributes (digging, treasures, rolling, the luck HUD) picks the boosts up automatically.
-- Profile field: d.Activity (sanitized here). Timed boosts only count down while the player is in the game.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local SS = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local DataService = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("DataService"))
local A = require(RS:WaitForChild("ActivityConfig"))

local B = {}
local event = {Snow = 1, Luck = 1}

function B.Sanitize(d)
	if type(d) ~= "table" then return nil end
	local a = type(d.Activity) == "table" and d.Activity or {}
	a.Boosts = type(a.Boosts) == "table" and a.Boosts or {}
	for kind, sec in pairs(a.Boosts) do
		if not A.Boosts[kind] or type(sec) ~= "number" or sec ~= sec or sec <= 0 then
			a.Boosts[kind] = nil
		else
			a.Boosts[kind] = math.min(sec, A.MaxBoostSeconds)
		end
	end
	a.Achievements = type(a.Achievements) == "table" and a.Achievements or {}
	a.Codes = type(a.Codes) == "table" and a.Codes or {}
	a.Quests = type(a.Quests) == "table" and a.Quests or {}
	a.Daily = type(a.Daily) == "table" and a.Daily or {}
	a.Daily.Day = tonumber(a.Daily.Day) or 0
	a.Daily.Last = tonumber(a.Daily.Last) or 0
	a.NextQuests = tonumber(a.NextQuests) or 0
	a.QuestsDone = tonumber(a.QuestsDone) or 0
	a.World2 = a.World2 == true
	a.Rate = tonumber(a.Rate) or 0
	if a.Rate ~= a.Rate or a.Rate < 0 or a.Rate == math.huge then a.Rate = 0 end
	d.Activity = a
	return a
end

-- always the live profile (OnLoaded hands later joiners a copy, so never keep that one)
function B.Profile(player)
	local d = DataService.Get(player)
	if d and type(d.Activity) ~= "table" then B.Sanitize(d) end
	return d, d and d.Activity
end

function B.Permanent(a)
	local s, l = 0, 0
	for id, have in pairs(a.Achievements) do
		local ach = have and A.AchievementById[id]
		if ach then s += ach.Snow or 0; l += ach.Luck or 0 end
	end
	return s, l
end

function B.Personal(a)
	local s, l = 1, 1
	for kind, sec in pairs(a.Boosts) do
		local k = A.Boosts[kind]
		if k and sec > 0 then s = math.max(s, k.Snow); l = math.max(l, k.Luck) end
	end
	return s, l
end

function B.Multipliers(player)
	local snow, luck = event.Snow, event.Luck
	local _, a = B.Profile(player)
	if a then
		local ps, pl = B.Personal(a)
		local qs, ql = B.Permanent(a)
		snow *= ps * (1 + qs)
		luck *= pl * (1 + ql)
	end
	return snow, luck
end

local function publish(player, a)
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	for kind in pairs(A.Boosts) do
		local sec = a and a.Boosts[kind]
		player:SetAttribute("BoostEnds_" .. kind, (sec and sec > 0) and (now + sec) or nil)
	end
	local s, l = 0, 0
	if a then s, l = B.Permanent(a) end
	player:SetAttribute("AchSnowBonus", s)
	player:SetAttribute("AchLuckBonus", l)
end

-- recompute this player's stats (UpgradeService listens to AdminHooks.ReapplyUpgrades)
function B.Refresh(player)
	local _, a = B.Profile(player)
	publish(player, a)
	local hooks = SS:FindFirstChild("AdminHooks")
	local ev = hooks and hooks:FindFirstChild("ReapplyUpgrades")
	if ev then ev:Fire(player) end
end

function B.Add(player, kind, seconds)
	local _, a = B.Profile(player)
	if not a or not A.Boosts[kind] or type(seconds) ~= "number" or seconds <= 0 then return false end
	a.Boosts[kind] = math.min(A.MaxBoostSeconds, (a.Boosts[kind] or 0) + seconds)
	B.Refresh(player)
	return true
end

function B.SetEvent(snow, luck)
	event.Snow, event.Luck = snow or 1, luck or 1
	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if DataService.Get(p) then B.Refresh(p) end
	end
end

function B.EventMultipliers() return event.Snow, event.Luck end

-- countdown (only while in the game)
task.spawn(function()
	local last = os.clock()
	while true do
		task.wait(1)
		local now = os.clock()
		local dt = now - last
		last = now
		for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			local d = DataService.Get(p)
			local a = d and d.Activity
			if type(a) == "table" and type(a.Boosts) == "table" and next(a.Boosts) then
				local expired = false
				for kind, sec in pairs(a.Boosts) do
					sec -= dt
					if sec <= 0 then a.Boosts[kind] = nil; expired = true else a.Boosts[kind] = sec end
				end
				if expired then B.Refresh(p) end
			end
		end
	end
end)

DataService.OnLoaded(function(player)
	local d = DataService.Get(player)
	if d then B.Sanitize(d); B.Refresh(player) end
end)

return B

-- and Pet Fuser (Pet Lodge). The server checks and does everything; MachinesClient only shows the panels. After a change it fires
-- the existing DataRefresh event, so the Inventory and Pet screens reload. Recipes and prices: ReplicatedStorage.MachineConfig.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local DataService = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("DataService"))
local Boosts = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("BoostService"))

local PetConfig = require(RS:WaitForChild("PetConfig"))
local A = require(RS:WaitForChild("ActivityConfig"))

local refreshEvent = RS:WaitForChild("DataRefresh")
local GoldenOf = PetConfig.GoldenOf or {}

local fn = Instance.new("RemoteFunction")
fn.Name = "MachineRemote"
fn.Parent = RS

local function copies(list, name)
	local n = 0
	for _, x in ipairs(list or {}) do if x == name then n += 1 end end
	return n
end
local function nice(x) -- 2 significant digits
	x = math.max(1, x)
	if x < 100 then return math.floor(x + 0.5) end
	local e = 10 ^ (math.floor(math.log10(x)) - 1)
	return math.floor(x / e + 0.5) * e
end

---------------- SHOVEL FORGE ----------------
local function variantOf(base, mutation)
	if not mutation then return Config.ByName[base] end
	for _, v in ipairs(Config.VariantsOf[base] or {}) do
		if v.Mutation == mutation then return v end
	end
	return nil
end
local function spareShovels(d, name) -- every equipped copy stays, and at least 1 copy for your Index
	return math.max(0, (d.Counts[name] or 0) - math.max(1, copies(d.Equipped, name)))
end
local function forgeList(d)
	local list = {}
	for _, item in ipairs(Config.Items) do
		local sources = {item}
		for _, v in ipairs(Config.VariantsOf[item.Name] or {}) do table.insert(sources, v) end
		for _, src in ipairs(sources) do
			local have = d.Counts[src.Name] or 0
			if have > 0 then
				for i, r in ipairs(M.Forge) do
					local target = r.From == src.Mutation and variantOf(item.Name, r.To)
					if target then
						table.insert(list, {Recipe = i, From = src.Name, To = target.Name, ToMutation = r.To, Need = r.Need, Have = have, Spare = spareShovels(d, src.Name)})
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return list
end
local function forge(player, d, recipe, from)
	local r = M.Forge[tonumber(recipe) or 0]
	local src = type(from) == "string" and Config.ByName[from]
	if not (r and src) or r.From ~= src.Mutation then return false, "That can't be forged" end
	local target = variantOf(src.Base or src.Name, r.To)
	if not target then return false, "That can't be forged" end
	if spareShovels(d, from) < r.Need then return false, ("You need %d spare %s"):format(r.Need, from) end
	d.Counts[from] -= r.Need
	d.Counts[target.Name] = (d.Counts[target.Name] or 0) + 1
	refreshEvent:FireClient(player)
	return true, "You forged a " .. target.Name .. "!", target.Name
end

local function drinkPrice(d, dr)
	local a = type(d.Activity) == "table" and d.Activity or {}
	local perMinute = math.max(M.Cocoa.MinSnowPerMinute or 50, (tonumber(a.Rate) or 0) * 60)
	return nice(perMinute * dr.PriceMinutes)
end
local function cocoaList(d)
	local list = {}
	for i, dr in ipairs(M.Cocoa.Drinks) do
		local b = A.Boosts[dr.Boost]
		list[i] = {Index = i, Name = dr.Name, Effect = (b and b.Name or dr.Boost) .. " for " .. math.floor(dr.Seconds / 60 + 0.5) .. " min", Price = drinkPrice(d, dr)}
	end
	return list
end
local function drink(player, d, i)
	local dr = M.Cocoa.Drinks[tonumber(i) or 0]
	if not dr then return false, "Unknown drink" end
	local price = drinkPrice(d, dr)
	if (tonumber(d.Snow) or 0) < price then return false, "Not enough Snow for " .. dr.Name end
	DataService.AddSnow(player, -price)
	Boosts.Add(player, dr.Boost, dr.Seconds)
	return true, "Yum! " .. dr.Name .. " is active."
end

---------------- PET FUSER ----------------
local function sparePets(d, name) -- equipped pets are never used
	return math.max(0, (d.Pets[name] or 0) - copies(d.EquippedPets, name))
end
local function fuserList(d)
	local list = {}
	for name, n in pairs(d.Pets) do
		local golden = GoldenOf[name]
		local pet = PetConfig.PetByName[name]
		if (tonumber(n) or 0) > 0 and golden and pet then
			table.insert(list, {From = name, To = golden, Need = M.Fuser.Need, Have = n, Spare = sparePets(d, name),
				Boost = pet.Boost, GoldenBoost = PetConfig.PetByName[golden].Boost, Rarity = pet.Rarity})
		end
	end
	table.sort(list, function(a, b) if a.Boost ~= b.Boost then return a.Boost > b.Boost end return a.From < b.From end)
	return list
end
local function fuse(player, d, from)
	local golden = type(from) == "string" and GoldenOf[from]
	if not golden then return false, "That pet can't be fused" end
	local need = M.Fuser.Need
	if sparePets(d, from) < need then return false, ("You need %d spare %s (equipped pets don't count)"):format(need, from) end
	d.Pets[from] -= need
	if d.Pets[from] <= 0 then d.Pets[from] = nil end
	d.Pets[golden] = (d.Pets[golden] or 0) + 1
	refreshEvent:FireClient(player)
	return true, "You made a " .. golden .. "!", golden
end

---------------- CRAFTING MACHINE (2026-10-03, Claude) ----------------
local CraftingConfig = require(RS:WaitForChild("CraftingConfig"))
local TreasureConfig = require(RS:WaitForChild("TreasureConfig"))
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local function recipeVisible(r)
	if r.Enabled ~= false then return true end
	return r.TestOnly == true and ServerStorage:GetAttribute("BalanceTestMode") == true -- example recipes: isolated tests only
end
local function spareTreasure(d, id) -- the last copy always stays in the Treasure Book
	return math.max(0, (tonumber((d.Treasures or {})[id]) or 0) - 1)
end
local function rewardValid(rw)
	if type(rw) ~= "table" then return false end
	if rw.Kind == "Boost" then return A.Boosts[rw.Boost] ~= nil end
	if rw.Kind == "Shovel" then return Config.ByName[rw.Item] ~= nil end
	if rw.Kind == "Pet" then return PetConfig.PetByName[rw.Pet] ~= nil end
	if rw.Kind == "Treasure" then return TreasureConfig.ById[rw.Treasure] ~= nil end
	if rw.Kind == "Snow" then return (tonumber(rw.Amount) or 0) > 0 end
	return false
end
local function craftList(d)
	local list = {}
	for i, r in ipairs(CraftingConfig.Recipes or {}) do
		if recipeVisible(r) and rewardValid(r.Reward) then
			local items, can = {}, (tonumber(d.Snow) or 0) >= (r.Snow or 0)
			for id, need in pairs(r.Treasures or {}) do
				local have = spareTreasure(d, id)
				table.insert(items, {Id = id, Need = need, Have = have})
				if have < need then can = false end
			end
			table.sort(items, function(x, y) return x.Id < y.Id end)
			table.insert(list, {Index = i, Id = r.Id, Name = r.Name, Text = r.Text, Snow = r.Snow or 0, Items = items, Can = can, Reward = r.Reward.Kind})
		end
	end
	local mats = {}
	for id, n in pairs(d.Treasures or {}) do
		local spare = math.max(0, (tonumber(n) or 0) - 1)
		if spare > 0 and TreasureConfig.ById[id] then table.insert(mats, {Id = id, Spare = spare}) end
	end
	table.sort(mats, function(x, y) return x.Id < y.Id end)
	return list, mats
end
local function craft(player, d, index)
	local r = (CraftingConfig.Recipes or {})[tonumber(index) or 0]
	if not (r and recipeVisible(r) and rewardValid(r.Reward)) then return false, "That recipe isn't ready yet" end
	if (tonumber(d.Snow) or 0) < (r.Snow or 0) then return false, "Not enough Snow" end
	for id, need in pairs(r.Treasures or {}) do
		if spareTreasure(d, id) < need then
			local t = TreasureConfig.ById[id]
			return false, ("You need %d spare %s"):format(need, t and t.Name or id)
		end
	end
	if (r.Snow or 0) > 0 then DataService.AddSnow(player, -r.Snow) end
	for id, need in pairs(r.Treasures or {}) do d.Treasures[id] -= need end
	local rw = r.Reward
	if rw.Kind == "Boost" then
		Boosts.Add(player, rw.Boost, rw.Seconds or 600)
	elseif rw.Kind == "Shovel" then
		d.Counts[rw.Item] = (d.Counts[rw.Item] or 0) + 1
	elseif rw.Kind == "Pet" then
		d.Pets[rw.Pet] = (d.Pets[rw.Pet] or 0) + 1
		d.PetIndex = d.PetIndex or {}; d.PetIndex[rw.Pet] = true
	elseif rw.Kind == "Treasure" then
		d.TreasureNew = d.TreasureNew or {}
		if (tonumber(d.Treasures[rw.Treasure]) or 0) == 0 then d.TreasureNew[rw.Treasure] = true end
		d.Treasures[rw.Treasure] = (tonumber(d.Treasures[rw.Treasure]) or 0) + 1
	elseif rw.Kind == "Snow" then
		d.Snow = (tonumber(d.Snow) or 0) + rw.Amount -- a prize, not digging income (same as the Lucky Wheel)
		DataService.SetStat(player, "Snow", d.Snow)
	end
	refreshEvent:FireClient(player)
	return true, "You crafted " .. (r.Name or r.Id) .. "!"
end

local busy = {}
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p) busy[p] = nil end)
fn.OnServerInvoke = function(player, action, a, b)
	local d = DataService.Get(player)
	if not d then return {Ok = false, Msg = "Still loading..."} end
	d.Counts = d.Counts or {}
	d.Equipped = d.Equipped or {}
	d.Pets = d.Pets or {}
	d.EquippedPets = d.EquippedPets or {}
	if action == "Forge" or action == "Drink" or action == "Fuse" or action == "Craft" then
		local now = os.clock()
		if busy[player] and now - busy[player] < 0.4 then return {Ok = false, Msg = "Slow down!"} end
		busy[player] = now
	end
	-- 2026-10-04 (Claude): the machines are locked until you own their unlock upgrade (UpgradeConfig.MachineUnlocks)
	local need = ({ForgeList = "UnlockForge", Forge = "UnlockForge", FuserList = "UnlockFuser", Fuse = "UnlockFuser", CraftList = "UnlockCraft", Craft = "UnlockCraft"})[action]
	if need and (tonumber(player:GetAttribute(need)) or 0) < 1 then
		return {Ok = false, Locked = true, Msg = "Locked - unlock it in the Upgrades tree!", List = {}}
	end
	if action == "ForgeList" then
		return {Ok = true, List = forgeList(d)}
	elseif action == "Forge" then
		local ok, msg, made = forge(player, d, a, b)
		return {Ok = ok, Msg = msg, Made = made, List = forgeList(d)}
	elseif action == "CocoaList" then
		return {Ok = true, List = cocoaList(d), Snow = d.Snow}
	elseif action == "Drink" then
		local ok, msg = drink(player, d, a)
		return {Ok = ok, Msg = msg, List = cocoaList(d), Snow = d.Snow}
	elseif action == "FuserList" then
		return {Ok = true, List = fuserList(d), Mult = PetConfig.GoldenMult or 2}
	elseif action == "Fuse" then
		local ok, msg, made = fuse(player, d, a)
		return {Ok = ok, Msg = msg, Made = made, List = fuserList(d), Mult = PetConfig.GoldenMult or 2}
	elseif action == "CraftList" then
		local list, mats = craftList(d)
		return {Ok = true, List = list, Mats = mats, Snow = d.Snow}
	elseif action == "Craft" then
		local ok, msg = craft(player, d, a)
		local list, mats = craftList(d)
		return {Ok = ok, Msg = msg, List = list, Mats = mats, Snow = d.Snow}
	end
	return {Ok = false, Msg = "Unknown"}
end

-- FrostKingService (2026-10-04, Claude): THE FROST KING - a rare co-op boss event. A giant penguin appears in a random snow field;
-- players may JOIN (stage unlocks respected), fight it with their orbiting shovels, and every qualifying fighter earns personal rewards.
-- The server owns everything: schedule, field choice, boss state, attack timing + hit tests, damage, participation and rewards.
-- FrostKingClient only draws it. Tunables: ReplicatedStorage.FrostKingConfig.
-- Studio tests (ServerStorage.BalanceTestMode = true): ServerStorage.FrostKingTestHook:Invoke("Start", {Field = id, Arrival = s, Target = s}) etc.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local SS = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local C = require(RS:WaitForChild("FrostKingConfig"))
local SF = require(RS:WaitForChild("SnowFields"))
local StageConfig = require(RS:WaitForChild("StageConfig"))
local Shovels = require(RS:WaitForChild("RNGConfig"))
local Balance = require(RS:WaitForChild("Balance"))
local PetConfig = require(RS:WaitForChild("PetConfig"))
local DataService = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("DataService"))
local Boosts = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("BoostService"))
local okT, Treasures = pcall(function() return require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("TreasureService", 10)) end)
if not okT then Treasures = nil end

local TEST = RunService:IsStudio() and SS:GetAttribute("BalanceTestMode") == true
local rng = Random.new()
local function now() return workspace:GetServerTimeNow() end
local function remote(class, name)
	local r = RS:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not r then r = Instance.new(class); r.Name = name; r.Parent = RS end
	return r
end
local event = remote("RemoteEvent", "FrostKingEvent")
local joinFn = remote("RemoteFunction", "FrostKingJoin")

local function flat(v) return Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z) end
local function hdist(a, b) return flat(a - b).Magnitude end
local function unitFlat(v) local f = flat(v); if f.Magnitude < 1e-3 then return Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end return f.Unit end
local function smooth(x) x = math.clamp(x, 0, 1); return x * x * (3 - 2 * x) end
local function nice(x)
	if x < 100 then return math.floor(x + 0.5) end
	local e = 10 ^ (math.floor(math.log10(x)) - 1)
	return math.floor(x / e + 0.5) * e
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- player power, reach and reward rate
--------------------------------------------------
local function realPower(player)
	local total, arms = 0, 0
	local bonus = player:GetAttribute("PowerBonus") or 0
	local pmult = player:GetAttribute("PowerMult") or 1
	for name in (player:GetAttribute("EquippedShovels") or ""):gmatch("[^,]+") do
		local item = Shovels.ByName[name]
		total += ((item and (item.Power or Balance.ShovelPower(item.Chance)) or 1) + bonus) * pmult
		arms += 1
	end
	return total, arms
end
-- event damage per second: log-scaled + capped, so beginners matter and endgame gear is faster but never instant
local function eventDps(player)
	local power, arms = realPower(player)
	if arms == 0 then return 0 end
	return C.Power.Base * math.clamp(1 + C.Power.LogStep * math.log10(math.max(1, power)), 1, C.Power.MaxMult)
end
-- how far the orbiting shovels reach (same formula as SnowFieldService)
local function reach(player)
	local rOut = SF.Spinner.Outer * (player:GetAttribute("ReachMult") or 1) * (player:GetAttribute("SizeMult") or 1)
	local maxSize = 1
	for name in (player:GetAttribute("EquippedShovels") or ""):gmatch("[^,]+") do
		local item = Shovels.ByName[name]
		if item and item.Size then maxSize = math.max(maxSize, item.Size) end
	end
	return 1.6 + (rOut - 1.6) * maxSize
end
local function stageAttr(style, attr)
	local stages = RS:FindFirstChild("SnowStages")
	local st = stages and stages:FindFirstChild(style)
	return st and st:GetAttribute(attr)
end
-- permanent Snow multiplier (upgrades x rebirth x achievements) and the temporary one (timed boosts x server events)
local function snowMults(player)
	local bs = math.max(player:GetAttribute("BoostSnowMult") or 1, 1e-6)
	local qs = 0
	local _, a = Boosts.Profile(player)
	if a then qs = Boosts.Permanent(a) or 0 end
	return (player:GetAttribute("SnowMult") or 1) / bs * (1 + qs), math.max(1, bs / (1 + qs))
end
-- theoretical active-digging Snow/s at the best unlocked field: the safe fallback and the clamp anchor
local function estimateRate(player)
	local spl, hp = stageAttr("Starter", "SnowPerPhase") or 1, stageAttr("Starter", "TileHP") or 1
	for _, s in ipairs(StageConfig.Order) do
		if player:GetAttribute("Stage_" .. s.Id) == true then
			local v = stageAttr(s.Id, "SnowPerPhase")
			if v and v > spl then spl, hp = v, stageAttr(s.Id, "TileHP") or hp end
		end
	end
	local power = realPower(player)
	local tiles = 9.5 * ((player:GetAttribute("ReachMult") or 1) * (player:GetAttribute("SizeMult") or 1)) ^ 2
	local revs = SF.Spinner.Speed * (player:GetAttribute("SpinMult") or 1) / (2 * math.pi)
	local layers = math.min(power * tiles * revs / math.max(1, hp), C.Rewards.MaxLayersPerSecond)
	local pets = {}
	for n in (player:GetAttribute("EquippedPets") or ""):gmatch("[^,]+") do table.insert(pets, n) end
	local petF = 1 + (PetConfig.Multiplier(pets) - 1) * (player:GetAttribute("PetBoostMult") or 1)
	return layers * spl * petF * (snowMults(player)) * C.Rewards.ActiveShare
end
-- the existing recent-digging speed (ActivityService a.Rate) without temporary boosts, kept inside a sane band around the estimate
local function rewardRate(player)
	local est = estimateRate(player)
	local _, temp = snowMults(player)
	local _, a = Boosts.Profile(player)
	local recent = a and (tonumber(a.Rate) or 0) / temp or 0
	if recent ~= recent then recent = 0 end
	if recent > 0 and est > 0 then return math.clamp(recent, est * C.Rewards.RateClamp[1], est * C.Rewards.RateClamp[2]) end
	return math.max(est, recent)
end
local function rewardSnow(rate) return nice(math.max(C.Rewards.MinSnow, rate * 60 * C.Rewards.SnowMinutes)) end

--------------------------------------------------
-- fields
--------------------------------------------------
local function infoOf(f)
	local ts = SF.TileSize
	local style = f.Style or "Starter"
	local stage = StageConfig.ById[style]
	local w, d = f.Width * ts, f.Depth * ts
	local groundY = f.Center.Y + 1
	local cx, cz = f.Center.X, f.Center.Z
	local info = {Id = f.Id, Def = f, Style = style, World = (stage and stage.World) or 1, W = w, D = d,
		Name = style == "Starter" and "the Starter Field" or ((stage and stage.Name) or style),
		GroundY = groundY, SnowY = groundY + C.Field.SnowTop, Center = Vector3.new(cx, groundY + C.Field.SnowTop, cz),
		Bounds = {minX = cx - w / 2, maxX = cx + w / 2, minZ = cz - d / 2, maxZ = cz + d / 2}}
	info.Entry = w >= d and Vector3.new(info.Bounds.minX + 5, groundY + 5, cz) or Vector3.new(cx, groundY + 5, info.Bounds.minZ + 5)
	return info
end
-- never bypass stage unlocks: Starter is open to everyone, everything else needs its stage
local function accessible(player, info)
	if info.Style == "Starter" then return info.World ~= 2 end
	return player:GetAttribute("Stage_" .. info.Style) == true
end
local lastFieldId
local function chooseField(forceId)
	local players = Players:GetPlayers()
	local list = {}
	for _, f in ipairs(SF.Fields) do
		local info = infoOf(f)
		if forceId then
			if f.Id == forceId then return info end
		elseif info.W >= C.Field.MinWidth and info.D >= C.Field.MinDepth then
			local n = 0
			for _, p in ipairs(players) do if accessible(p, info) then n += 1 end end
			table.insert(list, {info = info, n = n})
		end
	end
	local best = -1
	for _, e in ipairs(list) do best = math.max(best, e.n) end
	local pool = {}
	for _, e in ipairs(list) do if e.n == best then table.insert(pool, e.info) end end
	if C.Field.AvoidPrevious and #pool > 1 and lastFieldId then
		for i = #pool, 1, -1 do if pool[i].Id == lastFieldId then table.remove(pool, i) end end
	end
	if #pool == 0 then return nil end
	return pool[rng:NextInteger(1, #pool)]
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- boss state
--------------------------------------------------
local boss = nil
local joinCooldown = {}
local lastRewards = {}
local nextSpawnAt = 0

local function arenaPad() return C.Field.Margin + C.Boss.Radius end
local function clampArena(p, pad)
	local b = boss.info.Bounds
	pad = pad or 0
	return Vector3.new(math.clamp(p.X, b.minX + pad, b.maxX - pad), boss.info.SnowY, math.clamp(p.Z, b.minZ + pad, b.maxZ - pad))
end
local function inArena(pos)
	local b = boss.info.Bounds
	return pos.X >= b.minX - 4 and pos.X <= b.maxX + 4 and pos.Z >= b.minZ - 4 and pos.Z <= b.maxZ + 4 and math.abs(pos.Y - boss.info.GroundY) < 20
end
local function rootOf(player)
	local c = player.Character
	local r = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local h = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if r and h and h.Health > 0 then return r, h end
	return nil
end
local function hpShare(dps)
	local target = boss and boss.target or C.TargetSeconds
	return target * C.Uptime * C.Power.Base * (math.max(dps, C.Power.Base) / C.Power.Base) ^ C.Power.HPExponent
end
local function qualifies(p) return p.engaged >= C.Rewards.MinEngagedSeconds and p.hit >= C.Rewards.MinHitSeconds end
local function factorOf(p) return math.clamp(p.engaged / C.Rewards.FullEngagedSeconds, C.Rewards.PartialFloor, 1) end

local function participant(player)
	local p = boss.parts[player]
	if p then return p end
	p = {player = player, joined = now(), hp = C.Player.HP, invuln = 0, knockedUntil = 0, dmg = 0, hit = 0, engaged = 0,
		dps = eventDps(player), rate = rewardRate(player), refreshAt = now() + C.Power.DpsRefreshSeconds, rewarded = false}
	boss.parts[player] = p
	if boss.state == "Fight" and boss.placeholder then
		-- nobody was here when the fight began: the first fighter replaces the placeholder health (same % left)
		boss.placeholder = false
		local frac = boss.hp / math.max(1, boss.maxHP)
		boss.maxHP = math.max(C.Health.MinHP, hpShare(p.dps))
		boss.initialMax = boss.maxHP
		boss.hp = boss.maxHP * frac
	elseif boss.state == "Fight" then
		-- a late joiner adds health for the time that is left, smoothed in over time (see update)
		local remaining = math.clamp((boss.combatEnds - now()) / boss.combatSeconds, 0, 1)
		boss.pendingHP += hpShare(p.dps) * remaining * C.Health.JoinShare
	end
	return p
end

local function stateMsg()
	local n = 0
	for _, p in pairs(boss.parts) do if not p.fake then n += 1 end end
	return {T = "State", State = boss.state, HP = boss.hp, MaxHP = boss.maxHP, Phase = boss.phase, Pos = boss.pos, Facing = boss.facing,
		FightAt = boss.fightAt, Ends = boss.combatEnds, N = n, Recovering = boss.recovering, EndAt = boss.endAt, Result = boss.result}
end
local function actionMsg(a)
	return {T = "Action", Kind = a.Kind, T0 = a.T0, Windup = a.Windup, Active = a.Active, Recover = a.Recover, Data = a.Data, Phase = a.Phase}
end
local function spawnMsg()
	local i = boss.info
	return {T = "Spawn", Id = boss.id, FieldId = i.Id, Name = i.Name, Style = i.Style, World = i.World, Center = i.Center, W = i.W, D = i.D,
		GroundY = i.GroundY, SnowY = i.SnowY, Entry = i.Entry, FightAt = boss.fightAt, Ends = boss.combatEnds, Bounds = i.Bounds}
end

local function spawnBoss(opts)
	if boss then return nil, "A Frost King is already here." end
	opts = opts or {}
	local info = chooseField(opts.Field)
	if not info then return nil, "No valid field." end
	local t = now()
	local arrival = opts.Arrival or (TEST and C.Test.ArrivalSeconds) or C.ArrivalSeconds
	local combat = opts.Combat or C.CombatSeconds
	boss = {id = math.floor(t * 1000) % 1000000000, info = info, state = "Arrival", phase = 1, parts = {}, patches = {}, pendingHP = 0,
		pos = info.Center, facing = unitFlat(info.Entry - info.Center), fightAt = t + arrival, combatSeconds = combat,
		combatEnds = t + arrival + combat, target = opts.Target or C.TargetSeconds, hp = 1, maxHP = 1, initialMax = 1,
		nextActionAt = 0, lastState = 0, lastMe = 0, recovering = false}
	event:FireAllClients(spawnMsg())
	event:FireAllClients(stateMsg())
	return info.Name
end

local function startFight()
	boss.state = "Fight"
	local total = 0
	for _, p in pairs(boss.parts) do total += hpShare(p.dps) end
	boss.placeholder = total <= 0
	if total <= 0 then total = hpShare(C.Power.Base) end
	boss.maxHP = math.max(C.Health.MinHP, total)
	boss.hp = boss.maxHP
	boss.initialMax = boss.maxHP
	boss.nextActionAt = now() + 2.5
	event:FireAllClients(stateMsg())
end

local function teleportToEntry(player)
	local r = rootOf(player)
	if not r or not boss then return end
	local spot = boss.info.Entry + Vector3.new(rng:NextNumber(-4, 4), 0, rng:NextNumber(-4, 4))
	pcall(function() player:RequestStreamAroundAsync(spot, 6) end)
	if not boss or not player.Character then return end
	r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	player.Character:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(spot, Vector3.new(boss.pos.X, spot.Y, boss.pos.Z)))
end
-- every boss hit: invulnerability afterwards (no stun-lock); at 0 event health you are knocked out to the arena edge and recover
local function hitPlayer(p, dmg, push)
	local t = now()
	if p.fake or p.knockedUntil > t or p.invuln > t then return false end
	p.hp -= dmg
	p.invuln = t + C.Player.Invulnerable
	local knocked = p.hp <= 0
	event:FireClient(p.player, {T = "Hit", Damage = dmg, HP = math.max(0, p.hp), Push = push, Knocked = knocked})
	if knocked then
		p.hp = 0
		p.knockedUntil = t + C.Player.KnockoutSeconds
		p.invuln = p.knockedUntil + C.Player.RespawnInvulnerable
		task.spawn(teleportToEntry, p.player)
		event:FireClient(p.player, {T = "Knocked", Until = p.knockedUntil})
	end
	return true
end
local function eachTarget(fn)
	local t = now()
	for pl, p in pairs(boss.parts) do
		if not p.fake and p.knockedUntil <= t then
			local r = rootOf(pl)
			if r and inArena(r.Position) then fn(pl, p, r) end
		end
	end
end
local function focusPoint()
	local best, bd
	eachTarget(function(_, _, r)
		local d = hdist(r.Position, boss.pos)
		if not bd or d < bd then best, bd = r.Position, d end
	end)
	return best
end
local function grounded(p, r) return (r.Position.Y - (p.baseY or r.Position.Y)) < C.Attacks.Stomp.JumpClear end

--------------------------------------------------
-- attacks (all timing is broadcast; clients telegraph from the same data)
--------------------------------------------------
local function startAction(kind)
	local ph = C.Phases[boss.phase]
	local A = C.Attacks[kind]
	local t0 = now()
	local function w(x) return math.max(C.MinWarning, x / ph.Speed) end
	local focus = focusPoint() or boss.info.Center
	local dir = unitFlat(focus - boss.pos)
	local a = {Kind = kind, T0 = t0, Phase = boss.phase, Data = {}, hit = {}, ringHit = {}, pending = {}}
	if kind ~= "Stagger" then boss.facing = dir end
	if kind == "Slide" then
		a.Windup, a.Active, a.Recover = w(A.Windup), A.Dash, A.Recover
		local from = boss.pos
		local to = clampArena(from + dir * A.Length, arenaPad())
		a.Data = {From = from, To = to, Width = A.Width, Repeat = (ph.Final and not boss.slideRepeat) and 1 or 0}
	elseif kind == "Barrage" then
		local n = A.Count[boss.phase] or A.Count[#A.Count]
		a.Windup, a.Recover = w(A.Windup), A.Recover
		a.Active = (n - 1) * A.Interval + A.Flight
		local targets = {}
		eachTarget(function(_, _, r) table.insert(targets, r.Position) end)
		local balls = {}
		for i = 1, n do
			local base = #targets > 0 and targets[(i - 1) % #targets + 1] or (boss.pos + Vector3.new(rng:NextNumber(-18, 18), 0, rng:NextNumber(-18, 18)))
			local off = Vector3.new(rng:NextNumber(-A.Spread, A.Spread), 0, rng:NextNumber(-A.Spread, A.Spread))
			local launch = t0 + a.Windup + (i - 1) * A.Interval
			table.insert(balls, {Target = clampArena(base + off, 2), Launch = launch, Land = launch + A.Flight})
		end
		a.Data = {Balls = balls, Radius = A.Radius}
	elseif kind == "Breath" then
		a.Windup, a.Active, a.Recover = w(A.Windup), A.Duration, A.Recover
		local origin = boss.pos + dir * (C.Boss.Radius - 1)
		local patches = {}
		for i = 1, A.Patches do
			local dist = A.Range * (0.3 + 0.55 * (i - 1) / math.max(1, A.Patches - 1))
			local side = Vector3.new(-dir.Z, 0, dir.X) * rng:NextNumber(-dist * 0.3, dist * 0.3)
			table.insert(patches, clampArena(origin + dir * dist + side, 2))
		end
		a.Data = {Origin = origin, Dir = dir, Range = A.Range, HalfAngle = A.HalfAngle, Patches = patches, PatchRadius = A.PatchRadius, PatchSeconds = A.PatchSeconds}
	elseif kind == "Stomp" then
		a.Windup, a.Recover = w(A.Windup), A.Recover
		local rings = {t0 + a.Windup}
		if ph.Final then table.insert(rings, t0 + a.Windup + A.SecondRingDelay) end
		a.Active = (rings[#rings] - rings[1]) + (A.MaxRadius - C.Boss.Radius) / A.RingSpeed
		a.Data = {Rings = rings, Speed = A.RingSpeed, MaxRadius = A.MaxRadius, Start = C.Boss.Radius, Width = A.RingWidth, Center = boss.pos, Jump = A.Jump}
	elseif kind == "Spin" then
		a.Windup, a.Active, a.Recover = w(A.Windup), A.Duration, A.Recover
		a.Data = {Radius = ph.Final and A.FinalRadius or A.Radius}
	else -- Stagger: a readable pause + bonus-damage window on phase change
		a.Windup, a.Active, a.Recover = 0, C.StaggerSeconds, 0
	end
	boss.act = a
	event:FireAllClients(actionMsg(a))
end

local function processAction(a, t)
	local u = t - a.T0
	local A = C.Attacks[a.Kind]
	local W, ACT = a.Windup, a.Active
	if a.Kind == "Slide" then
		if u >= W and u <= W + ACT then
			boss.pos = a.Data.From:Lerp(a.Data.To, smooth((u - W) / ACT))
			boss.facing = unitFlat(a.Data.To - a.Data.From)
			eachTarget(function(pl, p, r)
				if not a.hit[pl] and hdist(r.Position, boss.pos) <= C.Boss.Radius + 1.5 then
					a.hit[pl] = true
					local side = Vector3.new(-boss.facing.Z, 0, boss.facing.X)
					if side:Dot(flat(r.Position - boss.pos)) < 0 then side = -side end
					hitPlayer(p, A.Damage, side * A.Push + Vector3.new(0, 30, 0))
				end
			end)
		elseif u > W + ACT and not a.landed then
			a.landed = true
			boss.pos = a.Data.To
		end
	elseif a.Kind == "Barrage" then
		for _, b in ipairs(a.Data.Balls) do
			if not b.done and t >= b.Land then
				b.done = true
				eachTarget(function(_, p, r)
					if hdist(r.Position, b.Target) <= a.Data.Radius then hitPlayer(p, A.Damage, unitFlat(r.Position - b.Target) * A.Push + Vector3.new(0, 35, 0)) end
				end)
			end
		end
	elseif a.Kind == "Breath" then
		if u >= W and u <= W + ACT then
			local o, dir = a.Data.Origin, a.Data.Dir
			local cosA = math.cos(math.rad(a.Data.HalfAngle))
			eachTarget(function(pl, p, r)
				if a.hit[pl] then return end
				local v = flat(r.Position - o)
				local d = v.Magnitude
				if d <= a.Data.Range and (d < 2 or v.Unit:Dot(dir) >= cosA) then
					a.hit[pl] = true
					hitPlayer(p, A.Damage, dir * A.Push + Vector3.new(0, 25, 0))
				end
			end)
		elseif u > W + ACT and not a.patched then
			a.patched = true
			for _, pos in ipairs(a.Data.Patches) do table.insert(boss.patches, {Pos = pos, R = a.Data.PatchRadius, Until = t + a.Data.PatchSeconds}) end
		end
	elseif a.Kind == "Stomp" then
		local d0 = a.Data
		if not a.slammed and t >= d0.Rings[1] then
			a.slammed = true
			eachTarget(function(_, p, r)
				if hdist(r.Position, d0.Center) <= C.Boss.Radius + 2.5 then hitPlayer(p, A.Damage, unitFlat(r.Position - d0.Center) * A.Push + Vector3.new(0, 40, 0)) end
			end)
		end
		local life = (d0.MaxRadius - d0.Start) / d0.Speed
		for k, rs in ipairs(d0.Rings) do
			local e = t - rs
			if e >= 0 and e <= life then
				local rad = d0.Start + d0.Speed * e
				a.ringHit[k] = a.ringHit[k] or {}
				eachTarget(function(pl, p, r)
					if a.ringHit[k][pl] then return end
					-- jump over the ring (airborne players are safe) or stay beyond its reach
					if math.abs(hdist(r.Position, d0.Center) - rad) <= d0.Width / 2 + 0.8 then
						if not grounded(p, r) then
							a.ringHit[k][pl] = true -- cleared it
						elseif not a.pending[pl] then
							a.pending[pl] = {t = t, k = k} -- lag forgiveness: a jump seen up to JumpGrace later still counts
						end
					end
				end)
			end
		end
		for pl, pend in pairs(a.pending) do
			local p = boss.parts[pl]
			local r = p and rootOf(pl)
			if not p or not r or a.ringHit[pend.k][pl] then
				a.pending[pl] = nil
			elseif not grounded(p, r) then
				a.ringHit[pend.k][pl] = true; a.pending[pl] = nil
			elseif t - pend.t >= C.Attacks.Stomp.JumpGrace then
				a.ringHit[pend.k][pl] = true; a.pending[pl] = nil
				hitPlayer(p, A.Damage, unitFlat(r.Position - d0.Center) * A.Push + Vector3.new(0, 45, 0))
			end
		end
	elseif a.Kind == "Spin" then
		if u >= W and u <= W + ACT then
			eachTarget(function(pl, p, r)
				if not a.hit[pl] and hdist(r.Position, boss.pos) <= a.Data.Radius then
					a.hit[pl] = true
					hitPlayer(p, A.Damage, unitFlat(r.Position - boss.pos) * A.Push + Vector3.new(0, 30, 0))
				end
			end)
		end
	end
	return u >= W + ACT + a.Recover
end
local function pickAttack()
	if boss.force then local k = boss.force; boss.force = nil; return k end
	local pool = C.Phases[boss.phase].Pool
	local choices = {}
	for _, k in ipairs(pool) do if k ~= boss.lastKind then table.insert(choices, k) end end
	if #choices == 0 then choices = pool end
	return choices[rng:NextInteger(1, #choices)]
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- rewards + end
--------------------------------------------------
local function grantRewards(p, result)
	local player = p.player
	local out = {Result = result, Qualified = qualifies(p), Engaged = math.floor(p.engaged), Hit = math.floor(p.hit), Damage = math.floor(p.dmg),
		NeedEngaged = C.Rewards.MinEngagedSeconds, NeedHit = C.Rewards.MinHitSeconds}
	if not out.Qualified then return out end
	local d = DataService.Get(player)
	if not d then out.Qualified = false; return out end
	local share = result == "Victory" and 1 or C.Rewards.EscapeShare
	local snow = nice(math.max(C.Rewards.MinSnow, rewardSnow(p.rate) * factorOf(p) * share))
	d.Snow += snow -- straight to Snow like the Lucky Wheel, so it can't inflate the digging-speed average
	DataService.SetStat(player, "Snow", d.Snow)
	out.Snow = snow
	if result == "Victory" then
		if Treasures and Treasures.GrantRandom and rng:NextNumber() < C.Rewards.TreasureChance then
			local ok, item = pcall(Treasures.GrantRandom, player, boss.info.Style, boss.info.Def)
			if ok and item then out.Treasure = item.Name or item.Id end
		end
		if rng:NextNumber() < C.Rewards.BoostChance then
			local kind = C.Rewards.Boosts[rng:NextInteger(1, #C.Rewards.Boosts)]
			local ok, res = pcall(Boosts.Add, player, kind, C.Rewards.BoostSeconds)
			if ok and res ~= false then out.Boost = kind; out.BoostSeconds = C.Rewards.BoostSeconds end
		end
	end
	return out
end
local function cleanup()
	if not boss then return end
	lastFieldId = boss.info.Id
	boss = nil
	event:FireAllClients({T = "Cleanup"})
	nextSpawnAt = now() + rng:NextNumber(C.Schedule.MinMinutes, C.Schedule.MaxMinutes) * 60
end
local function finish(result)
	if not boss or boss.state == "Defeat" or boss.state == "Escape" then return end
	boss.state = result == "Victory" and "Defeat" or "Escape"
	boss.result = result
	boss.endAt = now()
	boss.act = nil
	boss.patches = {}
	local me = boss
	event:FireAllClients(stateMsg())
	task.delay(result == "Victory" and C.DefeatSeconds or 2, function()
		if boss ~= me then return end
		lastRewards = {}
		for pl, p in pairs(me.parts) do
			if not p.fake and not p.rewarded and pl.Parent == Players then
				p.rewarded = true -- once per encounter, set before granting
				local ok, r = pcall(grantRewards, p, result)
				if not ok then warn("[FrostKing] reward failed: " .. tostring(r)); r = {Result = result, Qualified = false, Error = true} end
				lastRewards[pl.Name] = r
				event:FireClient(pl, {T = "Reward", Reward = r})
			end
		end
		task.delay(C.CleanupSeconds, function() if boss == me then cleanup() end end)
	end)
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- main loop
--------------------------------------------------
local function update(dt)
	if not boss then return end
	local t = now()
	if boss.state == "Arrival" or boss.state == "Fight" then
		for _, pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if not boss.parts[pl] then
				local r = rootOf(pl)
				if r and inArena(r.Position) and accessible(pl, boss.info) then participant(pl) end
			end
		end
	end
	if boss.state == "Arrival" then
		if t >= boss.fightAt then startFight() end
	elseif boss.state == "Fight" then
		if boss.pendingHP > 0 then
			local step = math.min(boss.pendingHP, boss.initialMax * C.Health.MaxGrowthPerMinute / 60 * dt)
			boss.pendingHP -= step; boss.maxHP += step; boss.hp += step
		end
		local anyone = false
		for pl, p in pairs(boss.parts) do
			if p.fake then
				local dmg = p.dps * C.Uptime * dt
				boss.hp -= dmg; p.dmg += dmg; p.engaged += dt; p.hit += dt * C.Uptime
			else
				if p.knockedUntil > 0 and t >= p.knockedUntil then
					p.knockedUntil = 0
					p.hp = C.Player.HP
					event:FireClient(pl, {T = "Recovered", HP = p.hp})
				end
				if t >= p.refreshAt then
					p.refreshAt = t + C.Power.DpsRefreshSeconds
					p.dps += (eventDps(pl) - p.dps) * 0.3
				end
				local r = rootOf(pl)
				if r and p.knockedUntil <= t and inArena(r.Position) then
					anyone = true
					p.baseY = p.baseY and math.min(r.Position.Y, p.baseY + dt * 1.5) or r.Position.Y
					local d = hdist(r.Position, boss.pos)
					if d <= C.Rewards.EngageRange then p.engaged += dt end
					if p.dps > 0 and d <= C.Boss.Radius + reach(pl) then
						local dmg = p.dps * dt * (boss.recovering and C.Power.RecoveryBonus or 1)
						boss.hp -= dmg; p.dmg += dmg; p.hit += dt
					end
				end
			end
		end
		boss.emptySince = (not anyone) and (boss.emptySince or t) or nil
		if #boss.patches > 0 then
			boss.patchTick = (boss.patchTick or 0) + dt
			if boss.patchTick >= C.Attacks.Breath.PatchTick then
				boss.patchTick = 0
				for i = #boss.patches, 1, -1 do
					local pa = boss.patches[i]
					if t >= pa.Until then
						table.remove(boss.patches, i)
					else
						eachTarget(function(pl, p, r)
							if hdist(r.Position, pa.Pos) <= pa.R and p.invuln <= t then
								p.hp = math.max(1, p.hp - C.Attacks.Breath.PatchDamage) -- frost chills but never knocks out on its own
								event:FireClient(pl, {T = "Hit", Damage = C.Attacks.Breath.PatchDamage, HP = p.hp, Frost = true})
							end
						end)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		boss.recovering = false
		if boss.act then
			local a = boss.act
			local done = processAction(a, t)
			local u = t - a.T0
			boss.recovering = (a.Kind == "Spin" and u > a.Windup + a.Active) or a.Kind == "Stagger"
			if done then
				boss.act = nil
				boss.lastKind = a.Kind
				local ph = C.Phases[boss.phase]
				if a.Kind == "Slide" and (a.Data.Repeat or 0) > 0 then
					boss.slideRepeat = true
					startAction("Slide")
					boss.slideRepeat = false
				elseif boss.pendingStagger then
					boss.pendingStagger = false
					startAction("Stagger")
				else
					boss.nextActionAt = t + rng:NextNumber(ph.Rest[1], ph.Rest[2])
				end
			end
		else
			local focus = focusPoint()
			if focus then
				local dir = unitFlat(focus - boss.pos)
				boss.facing = dir
				local d = hdist(focus, boss.pos)
				if d > C.Boss.KeepDistance then boss.pos = clampArena(boss.pos + dir * math.min(C.Boss.MoveSpeed * dt, d - C.Boss.KeepDistance), arenaPad()) end
				if t >= boss.nextActionAt then startAction(pickAttack()) end
			end
		end
		local f = boss.hp / math.max(1, boss.maxHP)
		local ph = (f <= C.Phases[3].Below and 3) or (f <= C.Phases[2].Below and 2) or 1
		if ph > boss.phase then
			boss.phase = ph
			event:FireAllClients({T = "Phase", Phase = ph})
			if boss.act then boss.pendingStagger = true else startAction("Stagger") end
		end
		if boss.hp <= 0 then
			boss.hp = 0
			finish("Victory")
		elseif t >= boss.combatEnds then
			finish("Escape")
		elseif boss.emptySince and t - boss.emptySince >= C.EmptyEscapeSeconds then
			finish("Escape")
		end
	end
	if not boss then return end
	if t - boss.lastState >= 0.2 then
		boss.lastState = t
		event:FireAllClients(stateMsg())
	end
	if t - boss.lastMe >= 1 then
		boss.lastMe = t
		for pl, p in pairs(boss.parts) do
			if not p.fake and typeof(pl) == "Instance" then
				event:FireClient(pl, {T = "Me", HP = p.hp, MaxHP = C.Player.HP, Engaged = p.engaged, Hit = p.hit, Qualified = qualifies(p),
					NeedEngaged = C.Rewards.MinEngagedSeconds, NeedHit = C.Rewards.MinHitSeconds, Reward = nice(rewardSnow(p.rate) * factorOf(p)),
					Knocked = p.knockedUntil > t and p.knockedUntil or nil, Damage = math.floor(p.dmg)})
			end
		end
	end
end

joinFn.OnServerInvoke = function(player, action)
	if action == "Sync" then
		if not boss then return nil end
		return {Spawn = spawnMsg(), State = stateMsg(), Action = boss.act and actionMsg(boss.act) or nil}
	end
	if not boss or (boss.state ~= "Arrival" and boss.state ~= "Fight") then return false, "There is no Frost King to fight right now." end
	if not accessible(player, boss.info) then return false, ("Unlock %s first!"):format(boss.info.Name) end
	if player:GetAttribute("IntroActive") then return false, "Finish the intro first!" end
	local r = rootOf(player)
	if not r then return false, "Wait until you respawn." end
	if (joinCooldown[player] or 0) > os.clock() then return false, "One moment..." end
	joinCooldown[player] = os.clock() + 3
	local spot = boss.info.Entry + Vector3.new(rng:NextNumber(-4, 4), 0, rng:NextNumber(-4, 4))
	pcall(function() player:RequestStreamAroundAsync(spot, 8) end)
	if not boss or not player.Character then return false, "The Frost King is gone." end
	r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	player.Character:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(spot, Vector3.new(boss.pos.X, spot.Y, boss.pos.Z)))
	player:SetAttribute("World", boss.info.World)
	participant(player)
	return true, "Good luck!"
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p)
	joinCooldown[p] = nil
	if boss then boss.parts[p] = nil end -- leaving gives no reward and never lowers the boss health
end)
local function watch(p)
	p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		local part = boss and boss.parts[p]
		if part then part.hp = C.Player.HP; part.knockedUntil = 0; part.baseY = nil end
	end)
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(watch)
for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do watch(p) end

nextSpawnAt = now() + rng:NextNumber(C.Schedule.MinMinutes, C.Schedule.MaxMinutes) * 60
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(5)
		if C.Enabled and not boss and now() >= nextSpawnAt and not (TEST and not C.Test.AutoSpawn) and #Players:GetPlayers() >= C.Schedule.MinPlayers then
			local ok, err = pcall(spawnBoss)
			if not ok then warn("[FrostKing] spawn failed: " .. tostring(err)) end
			if not boss then nextSpawnAt = now() + 120 end
		end
	end
end)
local acc = 0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	acc += dt
	if acc < 0.1 then return end
	local step = math.min(acc, 0.5)
	acc = 0
	local ok, err = pcall(update, step)
	if not ok then warn("[FrostKing] " .. tostring(err)) end
end)

-- Studio isolated tests only (BalanceTestMode)
if TEST then
	local hook = SS:FindFirstChild("FrostKingTestHook") or Instance.new("BindableFunction")
	hook.Name = "FrostKingTestHook"
	hook.OnInvoke = function(action, a)
		if action == "Start" then
			return spawnBoss(a)
		elseif action == "State" then
			if not boss then return {Active = false} end
			local parts = {}
			for pl, p in pairs(boss.parts) do
				parts[p.fake and p.name or pl.Name] = {DPS = p.dps, Damage = p.dmg, Engaged = p.engaged, Hit = p.hit, HP = p.hp, Rate = p.rate,
					Knocked = p.knockedUntil > now(), Qualified = qualifies(p), Preview = nice(rewardSnow(p.rate or 0) * factorOf(p))}
			end
			return {Active = true, State = boss.state, Field = boss.info.Name, FieldId = boss.info.Id, HP = boss.hp, MaxHP = boss.maxHP, Phase = boss.phase,
				Action = boss.act and boss.act.Kind, Pos = boss.pos, Parts = parts, EndsIn = boss.combatEnds - now(), FightIn = boss.fightAt - now(),
				Pending = boss.pendingHP, Patches = #boss.patches, Entry = boss.info.Entry}
		elseif action == "Attack" then
			if boss then boss.force = a; boss.nextActionAt = 0 end
			return boss ~= nil
		elseif action == "SetHP" then
			if boss and boss.state == "Fight" then boss.hp = boss.maxHP * a end
			return boss ~= nil
		elseif action == "Fake" then
			if not boss then return false end
			local dps = C.Power.Base * math.clamp(1 + C.Power.LogStep * math.log10(math.max(1, a or 1)), 1, C.Power.MaxMult)
			local fake = {fake = true, name = "Fake" .. rng:NextInteger(100, 999), dps = dps, dmg = 0, hit = 0, engaged = 0, hp = 100, knockedUntil = 0, invuln = 0, rate = 0}
			boss.parts[fake.name] = fake
			if boss.state == "Fight" and boss.placeholder then
				boss.placeholder = false
				boss.maxHP = math.max(C.Health.MinHP, hpShare(dps)); boss.initialMax = boss.maxHP; boss.hp = boss.maxHP
			elseif boss.state == "Fight" then
				local rem = math.clamp((boss.combatEnds - now()) / boss.combatSeconds, 0, 1)
				boss.pendingHP += hpShare(dps) * rem * C.Health.JoinShare
			end
			return fake.name, dps, hpShare(dps)
		elseif action == "Unfake" then
			if boss then for k in pairs(boss.parts) do if type(k) == "string" then boss.parts[k] = nil end end end
			return true
		elseif action == "End" then
			if boss then finish(a or "Escape") end
			return true
		elseif action == "Cleanup" then
			cleanup()
			return true
		elseif action == "Rewards" then
			return lastRewards
		elseif action == "Act" then -- the current attack (timing + data) for hit/dodge tests
			if not boss or not boss.act then return nil end
			local x = boss.act
			return {Kind = x.Kind, T0 = x.T0, Windup = x.Windup, Active = x.Active, Recover = x.Recover, Data = x.Data, Now = now(), Facing = boss.facing, Pos = boss.pos}
		elseif action == "Config" then -- tweak a tunable for a test: Invoke("Config", {"Rewards", "MinEngagedSeconds", 5})
			C[a[1]][a[2]] = a[3]
			return true
		elseif action == "Rate" then
			local power = realPower(a)
			return {Rate = rewardRate(a), Estimate = estimateRate(a), Snow = rewardSnow(rewardRate(a)), DPS = eventDps(a), Power = power, Reach = reach(a), HPShare = hpShare(eventDps(a))}
		end
		return nil
	end
	hook.Parent = SS
end
